source: Arcadis 2001 review of RISC (arcadis2001), Table R-8, legacy surface water mixing; Koc from spence2001 (RISC4 benzene)

tolerance.kind: half a unit in the last printed digit

note: The review reports exact agreement between RISC and its hand calculation, so this reproduces arithmetic and is not evidence of model accuracy. The table lists no Koc; 59 mL/g is a fixture input for this case only. The depth of SW is read as the discharge thickness d.
